machines.name: Aqua Starter
machines.description: Complimentary starter trial unit. Experience verified daily water performance telemetry and platform reward accounting.
machines.specifications: Multi-stage sediment filtration, 24V booster pump, digital flow sensor, 100L/day capacity.

machines.name: Aqua Basic
machines.description: Compact commercial water filtration unit suited for small retail kiosks and point-of-dispense monitoring.
machines.specifications: Dual carbon block filtration, UV sterilization lamp, stainless steel housing, 500L/day capacity.

machines.name: Aqua Plus
machines.description: Multi-stage RO purification station with digital flow-metering and enhanced community water reward capacity.
machines.specifications: Reverse osmosis 5-stage membrane, auto-flush system, TDS digital display, 1,200L/day capacity.

machines.name: Aqua Pro
machines.description: High-volume commercial mineralizer & alkaline dispenser with smart telemetry and continuous performance indexing.
machines.specifications: Commercial mineral injection cartridge, dual flow meters, remote GSM telemetry, 2,500L/day capacity.

machines.name: Aqua Premium
machines.description: Dual-line industrial grade water processor with UV purification and high-throughput community distribution.
machines.specifications: Heavy-duty industrial RO membranes, dual UV chambers, stainless distribution manifold, 5,000L/day capacity.

machines.name: Aqua Business
machines.description: Automated containerized water plant with remote telemetry and multi-village dispensing integration.
machines.specifications: Containerized treatment plant, PLC automated control panel, solar backup option, 10,000L/day capacity.

machines.name: Aqua Enterprise
machines.description: Municipal grade solar-assisted water purification station with heavy-duty pump telemetry and maximum reward indexing.
machines.specifications: Municipal scale treatment plant, solar PV integration, full telemetry dashboard, 25,000L/day capacity.
